subject.name: Photographic Processing Operators
subject.summary: Photographic process workers and processing machine operators (O*NET 51-9151.00) process film or digital images according to client specifications and laboratory procedures, operate photofinishing equipment, select images, produce photographs, and inspect finished quality. Working with work orders, original images, output quantities, media, color, and equipment status, they produce photographs or image files to specification, quality inspection records, and equipment anomaly handovers. Chemicals, equipment, electrical use, and client image privacy must be handled under institutional safety procedures and authorization. Work settings, qualifications, and final responsibility must be checked against local and institutional rules.
